## Structures

### `CpuState` { #cpustate }

User registers saved on exception entry: the trap frame. It sits at the top of the task's kernel stack, at kstack_top - sizeof(CpuState).

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `r` | [`Register`](#register) | r0-r12. |
| `sp_usr` | [`Register`](#register) | User-mode sp (r13_usr). |
| `lr_usr` | [`Register`](#register) | User-mode lr (r14_usr). |
| `return_pc` | [`Register`](#register) | Address execution resumes at. |
| `return_cpsr` | [`Register`](#register) | CPSR restored on return (the saved SPSR). |

### `CpuContext` { #cpucontext }

Kernel registers kept across a context switch, on the kernel stack.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `r4` | [`Register`](#register) | Callee-saved r4. |
| `r5` | [`Register`](#register) | Callee-saved r5. |
| `r6` | [`Register`](#register) | Callee-saved r6. |
| `r7` | [`Register`](#register) | Callee-saved r7. |
| `r8` | [`Register`](#register) | Callee-saved r8. |
| `r9` | [`Register`](#register) | Callee-saved r9. |
| `r10` | [`Register`](#register) | Callee-saved r10. |
| `r11` | [`Register`](#register) | Callee-saved r11 (fp). |

### `TaskRegs` { #taskregs }

A task's user registers, as TaskGetRegs() returns and TaskSetRegs() takes them.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `gp` | [`Register`](#register) | r0-r12. |
| `sp` | [`Register`](#register) | User sp. |
| `lr` | [`Register`](#register) | User lr. |
| `pc` | [`Register`](#register) | Address the task resumes at. |
| `flags` | [`Register`](#register) | CPSR; only ARM_CPSR_USER_BITS can be set. |
